prompt: Walk us through NIS2 incident reporting if ransomware takes down our production systems.
assertions: Early warning within 24 hours of awareness (indicating suspected unlawful/malicious cause or cross-border impact)
Incident notification within 72 hours with initial assessment of severity/impact and indicators of compromise
Final report within one month (or progress report if ongoing) with root cause, mitigation, and cross-border impact
Correct recipients: the CSIRT or competent authority (member-state specific), plus recipients-of-services notification where relevant
Applies the significance threshold: severe operational disruption/financial loss or considerable damage to others — ransomware downtime plainly qualifies
